name: Leeds
meta_description: Leeds brewery tours, beer tastings and food tours — from Northern Monk's taproom to the city's historic pubs and markets. Compare top experiences.
intro_md:
Leeds has brewing in its bones — this was Tetley's city for nearly two centuries, and the former brewery's art deco headquarters still stands south of the river. The modern scene is led by Northern Monk, whose taproom occupies a Grade II-listed former flax store in Holbeck, with a further cluster of breweries out along the Kirkstall Road corridor.

In the centre, start at Whitelock's Ale House, tucked down a narrow yard off Briggate and trading since 1715, then wander through Kirkgate Market — one of the largest covered markets in Europe — before picking a route through the bars around Call Lane and the railway arches of Granary Wharf.

Don't miss:

- Whitelock's Ale House, the city's oldest pub
- Northern Monk's taproom in Holbeck
- Kirkgate Market for lunch
- Canalside bars at Granary Wharf

gyg_tours.title: Leeds: Northern Monk Brewery Tour at Old Flax Store
gyg_tours.summary: A guided tour of Northern Monk's brewery in the historic Old Flax Store, covering the brewing process from grain to glass, with three third-pint tastings and a brewery glass to take home.
gyg_tours.description_md:
Join a guided tour of the original Northern Monk brewery, housed in the historic Old Flax Store in Leeds. Over around 90 minutes you'll explore the working brewery, learn how craft beer is made from raw ingredients through to serving, and hear the story of Northern Monk and its involvement in the local community. The experience includes tastings of the brewery's core and limited-edition beers.</description_md>
<parameter name="meeting_point">Northern Monk Refectory and Garden LDS, first floor (tour begins and ends here)
highlights: Guided tour of the original Northern Monk brewery
Explore the historic Old Flax Store
Learn how craft beer is made

gyg_tours.title: Leeds: Guided Food Tour with 7 Stops
gyg_tours.summary: A four-hour guided food tour of Leeds with seven stops, including the city's oldest pub, independent eateries, a bakery and Kirkgate Market.
gyg_tours.description_md: Discover the culinary side of Leeds on a four-hour guided walking food tour with seven stops. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, you will sample tastings at spots ranging from artisan bakeries and independent restaurants to street food at the covered market. Along the way you will hear local history, foodie facts and stories about the city, covering around a mile on foot.
highlights: Explore Kirkgate covered market street food
Sample artisan bakery and international bites
Local history, facts and ghost stories
Guided walk of around one mile
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Meet outside the Queens Hotel; your guide will wear a bright orange Leeds Food Tours hoodie or T-shirt.

gyg_tours.title: Leeds: Indian Food Tour with Tastings
gyg_tours.summary: A three-hour guided tour of Leeds' Indian food scene, sampling regional dishes across four restaurants with a knowledgeable local guide.
gyg_tours.description_md:
Discover the vibrant Indian food scene in Leeds on this guided walking tour. Over around three hours, you visit four of the city's top Indian establishments, sampling regional specialities from across the subcontinent. A knowledgeable local guide shares insights into Indian culinary culture and the chefs behind the signature dishes, taking in both established restaurants and newer venues.</description_md>
<parameter name="meeting_point">Next to the Black Prince Statue, Leeds
highlights: Mix of established and new venues
